name: USB microscope (Genesys Logic 05e3:0515)
notes: Reports itself as "USB2.0 UVC PC Camera" on a Genesys Logic chip; that chip maker's USB ID may also turn up in other cheap cameras. Delivers at most 640x480 natively (also 352x288, 320x240, 176x144, 160x120), reported as 25 fps; measured about 16-17 fps indoors. The device has only UVC interfaces and no keyboard (HID) interface, so a hardware photo button cannot reach the browser. Chrome on macOS exposes no hardware controls for it, so use the image sliders. Works plugged straight into a MacBook Air, no hub needed.
